'''Wyyyschokk''', also known as '''webweavers''', or '''Kashyyykian giant weavers''', were arachnids that lived in the lower levels of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk's]] "multilayered deathtrap" ecosystem. They were highly intelligent, though their intelligence level is unknown, as they were too dangerous to observe by living subjects, and [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were destroyed within minutes. In fact, wyyyschokk held the distinction of being the most dangerous predator on Kashyyyk, signifying them as one of the most dangerous in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Biology and appearance==
They were intelligent enough to coordinate ambushes on unsuspecting creatures, and had the tenacity to track their prey for over a [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]]. When attacking, they immobilized their victims with thick strands of web and copious amounts of [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] fluid from their upraised mandibles.<ref name="TFUn" />

While most wyyyschokk lived deep in the lower levels of the wroshyr forests, some populations could also be found in the [[Rodian Hunting Grounds|Etyyy region]] where no kilometer-high forests grew, while others lived in the [[ShadowWeave Caverns]] in the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]].<ref name="SWGROTW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>

==History==
A [[Color/Legends|blue]] wyyyschokk followed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Wayson Dower]] after [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] was decimated by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. After he regrouped with two other [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]&mdash;[[Milo Strander]] and [[Sterns Yennich]]&mdash;the spider continued to track the trio as they made their way back to their drop zone. Yennich, unaware of the danger, stepped into a clearing lacking adequate protection from below, and was attacked by the spider. After slicing through the trooper's leg [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armor]] with one of its [[Limb/Legends|legs]], causing a large amount of [[Blood/Legends|blood]] to flow, the wyyyschokk bit through the bark Yennich was standing on, piercing his chest. Curling into a ball due to the venom, he offered no resistance to the spider, which pulled him down for [[Foodstuff/Legends|consumption]].<ref name="pax">{{StoryCite|story=Pax Empirica&mdash;The Wookiee Annihilation|book=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>

About [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] sent his secret [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], to raise an [[Army/Legends|army]] to oppose the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]]. In order to gain the help of [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], he [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Great Jedi Purge)|journeyed]] to Kashyyyk to retrieve the [[Senator/Legends|senator's]] daughter, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. Making his way toward the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Skyhook (Kashyyyk)|skyhook]] anchor facility where she was being held, Marek encountered several giant weavers lying in wait for him. He barely survived the ambush and thereafter traveled through the upper levels of the jungle canopy.<ref name="TFUn" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' has an entry for "wyyyschok" (one ''k'') pointing back to the "webweaver" entry; however, under "webweaver," "wyyyschokk" is spelled with two ''k''{{'s}}, matching the spelling of older sources.

The spiders made a brief appearance under the name "Kashyyykian giant weaver" in [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]&mdash;written by [[Sean Williams]] and first published in [[2008]]&mdash;where they were described in retrospection.<ref name="TFUn" />
